description: Modify an existing booking: passenger name or phone, date or time, flight number, waiting minutes, passenger count, suitcases, car type or special requests. ALWAYS call it first with dry_run: true when the change touches the date, time, waiting minutes, passengers, suitcases or car: nothing is changed and the reply gives old_price, new_price and price_difference, so the customer hears the new price and says yes BEFORE the real call. CAR: the party must fit the car (code CAR_TOO_SMALL lists cars_that_fit with their prices; ask the customer which, then send car_type with passengers and suitcases). A new car is re-priced like a new time. A pay-the-driver booking is changed at once and the new price is paid to the driver. A booking already PAID BY CARD whose price would go up is not changed here: code PAY_DIFFERENCE_ONLINE gives manage_booking_url, where the customer makes the same change and pays the difference by card; give the customer that link. Identity is the booking reference plus the email address used on the booking (the same login as the website manage-booking page); the API rejects a mismatch. transfer_date and transfer_time are the planned PICKUP date and time (on an airport pickup that is landing plus the waiting minutes; the tool works out the landing time itself). No change of any kind is possible within 24 hours of the pickup (code TOO_LATE: the customer calls or WhatsApps the office). A change of date, time or waiting minutes is re-priced for the new time: the reply carries old_price, new_price and price_note, and the customer must be told the new price. A booking already paid by card whose price would go DOWN (a refund is the office's job), or one the office has edited, is refused with code CONTACT_OFFICE: the customer calls or WhatsApps the office. The email on a booking cannot be changed by this tool: it is the customer's key to the booking. A change request goes to info@aplcars.com from the original address, quoting the booking reference.

booking_ref.description: Booking reference — the numeric reservation ID shown on the confirmation email and the manage-booking page (e.g. "1013869").

changes.description: Object containing the fields to change

car_type.description: New car type: Saloon, People Carrier, 8 Seater, Executive Saloon, Executive MPV or Executive 8 Seater. Send it together with passengers and suitcases when the party has grown.

passenger_phone.description: New phone number with country code

waiting_time.description: Airport pickups only: minutes after landing at which the driver comes into the terminal (e.g. 30, 45, 60, 90). The pickup time moves with it.

dry_run.description: true = check only: nothing is changed; the reply says whether the change is allowed and gives the new price. Use it before any change that can move the price.

email.description: Passenger email on the booking — required, must match exactly

name: amend_booking
